heading.en: Origins and the founding of EDES

body.zh-Hant: 拿破崙·澤爾瓦斯生於1891年。他是希臘陸軍前軍官，因1935年親韋尼澤洛斯派政變失敗而遭開除軍職。1941年9月9日，澤爾瓦斯上校創立民族共和希臘聯盟（EDES）；其軍事部門民族希臘游擊隊群（EOEA）主要活躍於伊庇魯斯地區，在希臘抵抗組織中規模居次。
body.en: Napoleon Zervas was born in 1891. A former Greek army officer, he had been expelled after the failed pro-Venizelist coup of 1935. On 9 September 1941 Colonel Zervas founded the National Republican Greek League (EDES), whose military wing, the EOEA, was active mainly in Epirus; it was the second-largest Greek resistance group.

citations.quote: Ο Ναπολέων Ζέρβας (1891-1957)

heading.zh-Hant: 戈爾戈波塔莫斯高架橋行動

body.zh-Hant: 1942年11月，EDES領導人澤爾瓦斯於11月19日與英軍會面，次日ELAS領導人貝盧希奧提斯也與英軍會面；至11月22日作戰計畫定案：ELAS出86人、EDES出52人殲滅或牽制守軍，英國突擊隊負責在橋上佈置炸藥。11月25日深夜，戈爾戈波塔莫斯戰役打響，游擊隊自橋兩端攻擊，26日凌晨橋體兩處炸毀。這是英國特別行動處（SOE）至當時為止最大的一次行動。
body.en: In November 1942 Zervas, the EDES leader, met the British on 19 November, and ELAS leader Aris Velouchiotis met them the next day. By 22 November the plan was fixed: 86 ELAS men and 52 EDES men were to eliminate or distract the guards while the British placed the explosives. The attack began on the night of 25 November, and in the early hours of 26 November two parts of the bridge blew up; it was the biggest operation SOE had carried out until then.

heading.en: The Caserta agreement and the EDES zone

body.zh-Hant: 1944年9月21日，即協定簽署前五天，EDES宣布伊庇魯斯與凱法利尼亞進入圍城狀態，並實施軍事管制。9月26日的卡塞塔協定把約阿尼納、普雷韋扎、阿爾塔、伊古邁尼察，以及科孚與帕克索斯劃歸EDES管轄，ELAS則須自這些地區撤出。
body.en: On 21 September 1944, five days before the agreement was signed, EDES declared Epirus and Cephalonia in a state of siege and imposed martial law. The Caserta agreement of 26 September placed Ioannina, Preveza, Arta, Igoumenitsa, Corfu and Paxoi under EDES jurisdiction, and ELAS had to withdraw from them.

citations.quote: Ήδη από τις 21 Σεπτεμβρίου 1944, πέντε ημέρες πριν την υπογραφή της Συμφωνίας
ο ΕΔΕΣ κήρυξε σε κατάσταση πολιορκίας την Ήπειρο και την Κεφαλλονιά

heading.zh-Hant: 十二月事變、公共秩序部長與晚年
heading.en: The December events, Minister of Public Order and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1944年12月的「十二月事變」後，EDES被ELAS擊潰、失去有組織作戰力量，澤爾瓦斯的游擊隊逃往科孚島，重整後返回伊庇魯斯。戰後他出任公共秩序部長，任期自1947年2月23日至8月29日。他於1957年去世。
body.en: After the December 1944 events (Dekemvriana), EDES was broken as an organised fighting force by ELAS, and Zervas's guerrillas fled to Corfu, reorganised and returned to Epirus. After the war he served as Minister of Public Order from 23 February to 29 August 1947. He died in 1957.

citations.quote: Μετά τα Δεκεμβριανά και τη διάλυση του ΕΔΕΣ ως οργανωμένης
οι αντάρτες του Ζέρβα διέφυγαν στην Κέρκυρα

υπουργού Δημόσιας Τάξης από τις 23 Φεβρουάριου ώς τις 29 Αυγούστου 1947
ο οποίος πέθανε νωρίτερα (το 1957)

heading.en: The National Party and the 1946 elections

body.zh-Hant: 1945年3月，澤爾瓦斯創立的國家黨（ΕΚΕ，全名「國家抵抗黨」）成立。1946年3月31日大選前，他與民族政治聯盟（EPE）三位領袖一同要求改採多數制，但未獲接受；ΕΚΕ最後在20個選區推出候選人，得票率5.96%（66,027票），選出20名議員。Sfikas評論該黨在很大程度上倚賴前EDES成員在伊庇魯斯施加的恐嚇。
body.en: In March 1945 the National Party of Greece (EKE, full title Party of National Resistance), founded by Zervas, was set up. Before the elections of 31 March 1946 he and the three leaders of the National Political Union (EPE) asked for the contest to be held under the majority system, but were not heeded; EKE fielded candidates in 20 districts, took 5.96 per cent (66,027 votes) and elected 20 deputies. Sfikas judges that the party relied largely on intimidation by former EDES men in Epirus.

body.zh-Hant: 亨利·溫克爾曼1876年8月17日生於馬斯特里赫特。1931年他晉升少將並任第四師師長；1934年陸軍總參謀長一職出缺時，國防大臣提名的是雷恩德斯少將而非他，他反被晉升中將並在未提出請求下被送去退休。1939年動員令後他重返現役，自11月1日起任烏得勒支—蘇斯特貝赫防空區司令。
body.en: Henri Winkelman was born in Maastricht on 17 August 1876. In 1931 he was promoted major-general and commanded the 4th Division. In 1934, when the post of Chief of the General Staff fell vacant, the Minister of Defence put Major-General Reynders forward instead; Winkelman was promoted lieutenant-general and sent into retirement unasked. After mobilisation in 1939 he was recalled and from 1 November commanded the Utrecht-Soesterberg air defence region.

heading.zh-Hant: 陸海軍總司令與五月戰爭

body.zh-Hant: 1940年2月6日溫克爾曼被任命為陸海軍總司令，接替與政府在戰時法令適用上有深刻歧見的雷恩德斯。他主張防禦重心放在荷蘭心臟地帶；1940年5月荷蘭戰役爆發後，主要防禦落在艾瑟爾河後方的格雷伯防線。5月13日政府離境，授權他在他認為適當的時機投降，並使他成為荷蘭領土上的最高權威；他於5月15日在賴斯韋克簽署投降。
body.en: On 6 February 1940 Winkelman was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Land and Sea Forces, succeeding Reynders, who was deeply at odds with the government over the application of the War Law. He stressed defending the heart of the Netherlands; when the fighting came in May 1940 the main defence fell to the Grebbe Line beyond the IJssel. On 13 May the departing government authorised him to capitulate when he saw fit and made him the highest authority on Dutch territory; he signed the surrender at Rijsoord on 15 May 1940.

over te gaan tot capitulatie
hoogste gezagsdrager op Nederlands grondgebied
De overgave tekende hij te Rijsoord op 15 mei 1940

body.zh-Hant: 投降後溫克爾曼對占領者態度強硬；1940年7月1日至2日夜間，賽斯－英夸特下令將他逮捕，作為戰俘送往德國。他在被俘中度過戰爭，1945年5月12日返國，同年10月1日獲光榮退役。他於1952年12月27日在蘇斯特貝赫逝世。
body.en: After the capitulation Winkelman remained firm toward the occupier; in the night of 1–2 July 1940 Seyss-Inquart had him arrested and taken to Germany as a prisoner of war. He returned from captivity on 12 May 1945 and was honourably discharged from military service as of 1 October 1945. He died at Soesterberg on 27 December 1952.

body.zh-Hant: 卡雷爾·多爾曼1889年4月23日生於烏得勒支。他1906年起在海軍學院接受軍官養成，1910年8月24日獲任軍官；曾取得飛行證照，1918至1921年配屬德庫伊海軍航空基地。1934年6月至1937年9月4日他任海軍參謀長。
body.en: Karel Doorman was born in Utrecht on 23 April 1889. He began his naval-officer training in 1906 and was appointed an officer on 24 August 1910; he earned a pilot's brevet and from 1918 to 1921 was posted to the De Kooy naval air station. From June 1934 to 4 September 1937 he was chief of the naval staff.

body.zh-Hant: 日本對荷屬東印度發動進攻後，多爾曼自1942年2月3日起兼任一支盟軍艦隊的指揮官。2月26日，盟軍海軍司令赫爾夫里希命令他攻擊逼近的日本入侵艦隊。2月27日的爪哇海戰斷續進行逾七小時，他的五艘巡洋艦、九艘驅逐艦組成的艦隊幾乎全毀；他本人在旗艦上陣亡，旗艦約一個半小時後沉沒。
body.en: With the Japanese advance on the Netherlands Indies, Doorman also took command of an Allied squadron from 3 February 1942. On 26 February the Allied naval commander, Helfrich, ordered him to attack an approaching Japanese invasion fleet. The Battle of the Java Sea on 27 February lasted over seven hours with interruptions and almost wholly destroyed his squadron of five cruisers and nine destroyers; he was killed aboard the flagship, which sank after about an hour and a half.

body.zh-Hant: 據《荷蘭國家傳記辭典》，他在極短時間內把編組屢次變動的軍艦整成有效戰力；他的信號「Ik val aan, volg mij」並非戰役開始時所發，只是對他發出的「All ships - follow me」的非常自由的翻譯。1942年他被追授軍事威廉勳章三等騎士。
body.en: According to the Biografisch Woordenboek van Nederland, he turned the warships under his command into an effective force in very short time despite repeated changes of composition; the signal "Ik val aan, volg mij" was a very free translation of the "All ships - follow me" he actually sent. In 1942 he was posthumously made a Knight 3rd class of the Military William Order.

body.en: Conrad Helfrich was born in Semarang on 11 October 1886. He trained at the naval institute from 1903 to 1907 and specialised as a torpedo officer; at the end of 1928 he went to the Indies commanding the new destroyer Piet Hein, from 1931 to 1933 he was chief of staff of the naval forces in the Netherlands East Indies, and from December 1935 to December 1937 he commanded the Netherlands squadron there. From 16 February 1938 to 1 August 1939 he was director of the Higher Naval War College and was promoted rear-admiral on 1 September 1938.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月赫爾夫里希再赴印度，接任海軍司令兼海軍部負責人；他事先準備數月，12月18日才正式出任，接替費爾維達中將。1941年8月31日他晉升中將。對日戰爭初期，他獨立指揮荷蘭海軍與海軍航空兵力；荷蘭潛艇的戰績讓他在美國媒體得到「一日一艦赫爾夫里希」的綽號。籌組ABDACOM時，他未列入該組織高層。
body.en: In September 1939 Helfrich went to the Indies again to become Commander of the Navy and head of the Navy Department; after some months of preparation he took over as fleet commander only on 18 December, succeeding Vice-Admiral Ferwerda. He was promoted vice-admiral on 31 August 1941. In the early phase of the war with Japan he independently directed the Dutch naval and naval air forces; the successes of Dutch submarines earned him the nickname "ship-a-day Helfrich" in the American press. When ABDACOM was formed he was not included in its top.

heading.en: ABDA naval commander and the Java Sea

body.zh-Hant: 1942年2月14日，赫爾夫里希接替美國海軍上將哈特，出任ABDACOM地區盟軍海軍總司令。他的方針是堅守到底，並在其倡議下組成聯合打擊部隊，由多爾曼指揮。2月27日爪哇海戰失利後，他仍嘗試說服英美下屬發動盡可能大規模的潛艇攻勢；3月2日他奉總督之命撤往錫蘭。
body.en: On 14 February 1942 Helfrich succeeded the American Admiral Thomas C. Hart as supreme commander of the Allied naval forces in the ABDACOM area. His policy was to hold out to the utmost, and on his instigation the Combined Striking Force was formed under Doorman. Even after the defeat in the Battle of the Java Sea on 27 February he tried to get his British and American subordinates to join a massive submarine offensive; on 2 March he evacuated to Ceylon on the governor-general's order.

body.zh-Hant: 撤往錫蘭後，赫爾夫里希以可倫坡為駐地，任荷蘭東方武裝力量司令（BSO），這是純行政性職務。1945年9月2日他代表荷蘭政府在「密蘇里」號上簽署日本投降書；10月1日抵巴達維亞，至1946年1月24日BSO職務撤銷前指揮在印尼的荷蘭軍隊。1945年8月25日他被任為海軍司令（BDZ）並晉升海軍上將，1948年10月1日退休。他於1962年9月20日在海牙去世。
body.en: From Colombo Helfrich acted as Netherlands Commander of the Forces in the East (BSO), a purely administrative function. On 2 September 1945 he signed Japan's Instrument of Surrender for the Netherlands government aboard the Missouri; he arrived at Batavia on 1 October and commanded the Dutch forces in Indonesia until 24 January 1946, when the BSO post was abolished. Appointed Commander of the Naval Forces (BDZ) on 25 August 1945 with promotion to lieutenant-admiral, he retired on 1 October 1948 and died in The Hague on 20 September 1962.

body.zh-Hant: 海因·德波登1887年11月21日生於茂物，1908年7月25日自布雷達軍校畢業，任荷屬東印度軍（KNIL）砲兵少尉。1911年8月30日他成為首位取得國際飛行證照的荷蘭職業軍官。1916年2月他駕機墜毀，同機的陸軍司令米歇爾森中將罹難。1937年9月他升任少將，1939年7月任總參謀長。
body.en: Hein ter Poorten was born at Buitenzorg on 21 November 1887 and left the military academy at Breda on 25 July 1908 as a second lieutenant of artillery in the KNIL. On 30 August 1911 he became the first Dutch professional officer to obtain the international pilot's brevet. In February 1916 he crashed an aircraft, killing the army commander, Lieutenant-General Michielsen, who flew as passenger. He became major-general in September 1937 and chief of the general staff in July 1939.

heading.en: Army commander and the Java campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1941年10月13日陸軍司令貝倫肖特死於空難，德波登接任陸軍司令與戰爭部長兩職並升中將。1942年1月在韋維爾領導下成立ABDA司令部，總部設於西爪哇隆邦；他進入韋維爾幕僚，但仍統率東印度軍隊。2月25日ABDA司令部解散，他只能以KNIL的四個團與少數澳英部隊守衛爪哇。3月1日日軍登陸，3月5日總督把最高統帥權交給他，8日他在卡利查蒂與日軍司令今村均談判，9日KNIL投降。
body.en: On 13 October 1941 the army commander, Berenschot, died in a flying accident and Ter Poorten succeeded him in both posts, army commander and head of the Department of War, being promoted lieutenant-general. In January 1942 the ABDA command was formed under Wavell with headquarters at Lembang in West Java; he joined Wavell's staff but kept command of the Indies army. After ABDA was dissolved on 25 February he had to defend Java with four KNIL regiments and a few Australian and British troops. The Japanese landed on 1 March; on 5 March the governor-general handed him the supreme command, and after the 8 March meeting with the Japanese commander Imamura the KNIL capitulated on 9 March.

body.zh-Hant: 投降後德波登成為戰俘，先在爪哇，之後移往台灣，1944年10月起在滿洲，1945年8月17日獲解放。他於1945年11月請辭，1946年2月28日獲准。他認為自己是東印度軍事潰敗的替罪羊。他於1968年1月15日在海牙去世。
body.en: After the capitulation Ter Poorten was a prisoner of war, first on Java, then on Taiwan, and from October 1944 in Manchuria, where he was liberated on 17 August 1945. He asked for discharge in November 1945, granted as of 28 February 1946. He felt he had been made the scapegoat for the military debacle in the Indies. He died in The Hague on 15 January 1968.
